remarks: ***HIGHEST AND BEST DUE 9/1 AT 10:00AM TO LISTING AGENT EMAIL*** Welcome to 29 Lynn Court, a charming four-bedroom home tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in the heart of Darien. Offering a wonderful combination of comfortable living spaces, a private setting and an exceptional neighborhood feel, this is a home designed for easy everyday living. Inside, a welcoming layout offers plenty of space to gather, relax and make your own. The kitchen features appliances that are less than a year old, while four bedrooms provide flexibility for family, guests or a home office.  Outside, enjoy a lovely back deck, patio and yard and one of the best parts of Lynn Court, its true sense of community. Neighbors gather for an annual block party each September and welcome a special holiday visitor every December, beloved traditions that make this street feel especially warm and connected.  Located in the highly desirable Holmes Elementary School district, 29 Lynn Court puts you close to everything that makes Darien such an incredible place to live. Enjoy award-winning schools, beautiful parks and beaches, a vibrant downtown, great restaurants and shopping, and an easy commute with Metro-North and I-95 just minutes away.  With its cul-de-sac setting, welcoming neighborhood and unbeatable Darien location, 29 Lynn Court offers an opportunity to put down roots and enjoy all that this special community has to offer.
